\begin{abstract}
Within Static Holographic Boundary Theory (SHBT), the macroscopic
spacetime metric is generated by holographic renormalization-group flow
from a microscopic quantum algebraic boundary register rather than
postulated ad hoc. We present the canonical engineering digital twin: a
12-crate Rust workspace, a freestanding C11 microkernel, and a 3+1D
numerical spacetime simulator implementing the $(26, 8, 312)$ WZW affine
branch, exact ghost-sector framing cancellation ($\Delta_{\mathrm{fr}}
\equiv 0$), a 128-byte dual-cacheline MMIO contract, a $2.140$~ns PCSS
crowbar interlock, an $8\times 8$ InP/InGaAsP PIC emitter array, a
1{,}800-module LANR power ledger, and a five-stage minimum-jerk flight
program. All \WarpGatesPassed/\WarpGatesTotal{} verification checks pass
and all eight Z3 SMT theorems discharge with \texttt{unsat}.
\end{abstract}



% ==================== I ====================
\section{Introduction \& Holographic Spacetime Foundations}
\label{sec:intro}

Classical general relativity treats faster-than-light warp geometries by
deforming the metric tensor phenomenologically, imposing unconstrained
negative energy distributions without a microphysical mechanism for
metric evolution. In SHBT, the bulk line element emerges dynamically from
the boundary through the Fefferman--Graham gauge. In an asymptotically
locally anti-de~Sitter $(d+1)$-dimensional spacetime with AdS radius
$\ell$,
\begin{equation}
  ds^2 = G_{MN}\,dx^M dx^N
       = \frac{\ell^2}{z^2}\left[dz^2 + g_{\mu\nu}(x,z)\,dx^\mu dx^\nu\right],
\end{equation}
where $z\in(0,z_{\mathrm{IR}}]$ is the holographic radial coordinate and
$x^\mu=(t,\mathbf{x})$ are the boundary coordinates. Einstein's equations
with $\Lambda=-d(d-1)/(2\ell^2)$ enforce the asymptotic expansion
\begin{equation}
  g_{\mu\nu}(x,z) = g_{\mu\nu}^{(0)}(x) + z^2 g_{\mu\nu}^{(2)}(x)
    + \dots + z^d g_{\mu\nu}^{(d)}(x) + h_{\mu\nu}^{(d)}(x) z^d \ln z^2
    + \mathcal{O}(z^{d+1}).
\end{equation}
Evaluating the holographic slice at the IR confinement scale $z=z_0$
projects the emergent metric into the ADM $3{+}1$ foliation
\begin{equation}
  ds^2 = -\alpha^2 dt^2 + \gamma_{ij}(dx^i+\beta^i dt)(dx^j+\beta^j dt).
\end{equation}
Longitudinal transport along $x$ is driven by the off-diagonal boundary
momentum density, mapping to the shift vector
\begin{equation}
  \beta^x(t,\mathbf{x}) = -v_s(t)\,
    \exp\!\left(\tfrac{\Delta_{\mathrm{mod}}}{2}\right)
    f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}(\mathbf{x}),
\end{equation}
with the localized bubble envelope
\begin{equation}
  f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}(r) =
    \frac{\tanh\!\bigl(\sigma_w(r+R)\bigr)
         -\tanh\!\bigl(\sigma_w(r-R)\bigr)}
         {2\tanh(\sigma_w R)}.
\end{equation}
For $r\ll R$, $f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}\to 1$ giving an unperturbed flat cabin;
for $r\gg R$, $f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}\to 0$ recovering exterior Minkowski
space.

% ==================== II ====================
\section{Algebraic Boundary Register \& Framing Cancellation}
\label{sec:boundary}

The boundary CFT register is a compact Wess--Zumino--Witten affine
Kac--Moody algebra over the product group manifold
$\mathcal{G} = SU(2)_{k_l}\times SU(3)_{k_q}\times SO(10)_{K}$
on the canonical level triple $(k_l,k_q,K)=(26,8,312)$. The Sugawara
central charge $c(G_k)=k\dim(G)/(k+h^\vee)$ evaluates to
\begin{align}
  c_1 &= \frac{26\times 3}{26+2}=\frac{78}{28}=\frac{39}{14}\approx2.785714,\\
  c_2 &= \frac{8\times 8}{8+3}=\frac{64}{11}\approx5.818182,\\
  c_3 &= \frac{312\times45}{312+8}=\frac{14040}{320}=\frac{351}{8}=43.875,
\end{align}
so the total Virasoro charge is
\begin{equation}
  c_{\mathrm{total}} = c_1+c_2+c_3
    = \frac{39}{14}+\frac{64}{11}+\frac{351}{8}
    \approx 52.478896.
\end{equation}
The reparametrization ghost sector carries exactly $c_{\mathrm{ghost}} =
c_{\mathrm{total}}$, yielding an exact modular framing cancellation
\begin{equation}
  \Delta_{\mathrm{fr}} = \frac{c_{\mathrm{total}}-c_{\mathrm{ghost}}}{24}
    \bmod 1 \equiv 0
  \quad\Longrightarrow\quad E_{\mu\nu}\equiv 0,
\end{equation}
eliminating the bulk stress-energy projection anomaly. The branching
order decomposes into $\eta_A=10/33$ active characters and
$\eta_D=23/33$ dark-ledger characters (10 active + 23 dark modes of the
$33$-slot register). All boundary arithmetic is evaluated at 512-bit
MPFR precision in \texttt{warp-boundary-cft}; the modular $S$-matrix
satisfies $\lVert S^\dagger S - I\rVert \le 10^{-15}$.

\section{Energy Conditions, Dark Ledger \& Quantum Inequalities}
\label{sec:ec}

The Eulerian energy density sourced by the wall is
\begin{equation}
  \rho_{\mathrm{Eulerian}}
    = -\frac{v_s^2\,e^{\Delta_{\mathrm{mod}}}}{32\pi}
      \frac{y^2+z^2}{r^2}\left(\partial_r f\right)^2 \le 0,
\end{equation}
so the wall carries genuine NEC violation, balanced by the macroscopic
Stinespring partition $\eta_A=10/33$, $\eta_D=23/33$. The dark ledger
embeds 124 Fibonacci braid descriptors whose aggregate topological
backreaction
\begin{equation}
  C_{\mathrm{braid}}
    = \sum_{k=1}^{124}\operatorname{Re}\!\left(
      1-e^{2\pi i F_{k-1}/F_{k+2}}\right)

Pointwise WEC/NEC/SEC/DEC evaluators and a Ford--Roman sampler over
$\tau_0\ge\tau_{\mathrm{Planck}}$ verify

The battery enters the Ford--Roman ledger as a positive-injection term:

\end{equation}
so the dual-ledger accounting keeps the $+93.054$~kW raw
($+33.104$~kW net) LANR margin for housekeeping while the isomer
discharge closes the burst-drive energy balance.

\section{The SHBT-EW-312 Traversable Effective Wormhole System}
\label{sec:wormhole}

Classical 3+1D Einstein--Rosen handles $\mathbb{T}^3 \# (S^2 \times S^1)$ are strictly forbidden by general relativistic and holographic constraints: spatial metric degeneracy causes $\mathrm{rank}(\gamma_{ij}) < 3$ at the throat pinch, the lapse function collapses ($\alpha \to 0$), CCZ4 conformal expansion diverges ($\lVert\Theta\rVert_\infty \to \infty$), entropy consumption violates the causal point bound ($R_{\mathrm{entropy}}^{\mathrm{exp}} < 0$), and static Minkowski traversal admits spacelike lightcone violations ($\Delta s^2_{\mathrm{2PN}} > 0$). The \texttt{SHBT-EW-312} architecture resolves these pathologies by replacing physical geometric bulk throats with an effective topological corridor operating across four distinct stages:

\begin{enumerate}
  \item \textbf{Stage 1 --- Macroscopic Stinespring Ingestion ($V_{\mathrm{unified}}^{\mathrm{macro}}$):} Scans and folds macroscopic payloads $N_{\mathrm{local}} \in [10^{23}, 10^{28}]$ nucleons ($16.6$~metric tons, $B \approx 1.25\times 10^{28}$~bits, $E_{\mathrm{fold}} = 455.75$~TJ) into $\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{active}}^{\mathrm{macro}} \otimes \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{dark}}^{\mathrm{macro}}$ with trace norm preservation $\Delta_{\mathrm{norm}} < 10^{-120}$ and code norm $\lVert W^\dagger W - P_{\mathrm{code}}\rVert_{\mathrm{op}} = 3.430\times 10^{-3} \le 3.5\times 10^{-3}$ (GATE-EW-02..04: \csname WarpGATEEW02\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW03\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW04\endcsname). With $94.20\%$ SMES inductive recovery, net cycle energy loss is bounded to $\Delta E_{\mathrm{cycle}} = 26.4335$~TJ $\le 45.575$~TJ (GATE-EW-05: \csname WarpGATEEW05\endcsname). Folding latency scales with reactor power: $9{,}126$~ms (baseline $^{178\mathrm{m2}}$Hf), $509.1$~ms (Continuous Cruise), $66.98$~ms (Sustained Burst), and $0.508$~ms (Exawatt Impulse; GATE-EW-06: \csname WarpGATEEW06\endcsname).
  \item \textbf{Stage 2 --- Quiescent Dark-Ledger Buffering \& Gauge Decoupling:} Locks the payload into the dark ledger ($\eta_D = 23/33$) across 124 Fibonacci anyon braid channels ($C_{\mathrm{braid}} \approx 38.196601$~nats, $\epsilon_{\mathrm{SK9}} \le 10^{-230.1937}$, Blossom-V TQEC $\tau_{\mathrm{decode}} = 41.8$~ns $\le 45.0$~ns, $P_L = 8.4\times 10^{-13}$; GATE-EW-07..10: \csname WarpGATEEW07\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW08\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW09\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW10\endcsname). Orthogonal gauge rotation decouples the payload from $\hat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_{26} \times \hat{\mathfrak{su}}(3)_8$, causing interaction cross-sections to vanish identically ($\sigma_{\mathrm{collision}} \equiv 0$; GATE-EW-11: \csname WarpGATEEW11\endcsname).
  \item \textbf{Stage 3 --- Symplectic Heegaard--Floer Routing Across the Shift-Sheared Corridor:} Propagates the dark-ledger state via $T^\partial_{ij} \in \mathrm{Sp}(2g, \mathbb{Z})$ over the $504$~Gbps DMA ring ($Z_0 = 50.12~\Omega$, TMSV $r = 2.50, 21.715$~dB, $3\sigma \le 0.084$~nm; GATE-EW-12..13: \csname WarpGATEEW12\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW13\endcsname) through the shift-sheared ADM soliton $\beta^x = -v_s \exp(\Delta_{\mathrm{mod}}/2) f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}$ on the 5th-order minimum-jerk profile ($|s''|\le 5.7735$; GATE-EW-14..15: \csname WarpGATEEW14\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW15\endcsname). Dragged superluminal lightcones guarantee 2PN causal satisfaction ($\Delta s^2_{\mathrm{2PN}} \le 0$), zero comoving acceleration ($a_i = 0$), and positive Ford--Roman energy density ($\langle T_{\mathrm{ren}}\rangle > 0$; GATE-EW-16..18: \csname WarpGATEEW16\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW17\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW18\endcsname).
  \item \textbf{Stage 4 --- Causal Egress, Adjoint Re-Rendering \& In-Situ Fuel Co-Crystallization ($(V_{\mathrm{unified}}^{\mathrm{macro}})^\dagger \Pi_{\mathrm{history}}$):} Reconstructs the visible baryonic state at the destination rest frame ($\alpha = 1.0, \beta^i = 0, \gamma_{ij} = \delta_{ij}$) with zero egress entropy ($\Delta S_{\mathrm{egress}} \equiv 0$; GATE-EW-19: \csname WarpGATEEW19\endcsname), and optionally invokes $\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{synth}}^{\mathrm{MAR}}$ to co-crystallize a fresh $376.99$~kg \texttt{SHBT-MAR-312} core from local asteroid regolith (Mode~1b: $3.146$~s at Burst power) or natural feedstock (Mode~1a: $0.3115$~s at Burst power; GATE-SYNTH-08: \csname WarpGATESYNTH08\endcsname).
\end{enumerate}

The system operates under two Concept of Operations (ConOps) modes:
\textbf{Mode A (Fixed Dual-Terminal Stargate Network)} enables stationary gateways dispatching up to $743{,}438$ full $16.6$~t payloads per $376.99$~kg core ($1.234\times 10^7$~t cumulative mass), yielding continuous throughput of $878{,}824$~t/hr ($244.12$~t/s) in Sustained Burst and $117{,}383$~t/hr in Continuous Cruise (GATE-EW-20..21: \csname WarpGATEEW20\endcsname, \csname WarpGATEEW21\endcsname).
\textbf{Mode B (Self-Contained Mobile Jump-Cruiser)} allows a standalone ship to fold its entire hull and crew ($N_{\mathrm{local}} \le 10^{28}$) into the dark ledger while riding its self-generated metric corridor (GATE-EW-22: \csname WarpGATEEW22\endcsname). Across multi-hop galactic jumps (Mission~3 Sgr~A* $10$-hop Impulse and Mission~4 Milky Way $3$-hop Burst / $39$-hop Impulse), closed-loop breeder refueling consumes $<0.071\%$ of residual reserve energy per hop with refueling downtime $<10^{-7}$ of active transit time (GATE-SYNTH-08: \csname WarpGATESYNTH08\endcsname). \section{Conclusions \& Implementation Roadmap}
\label{sec:conc}

The framework resolves the open boundary conditions of SHBT warp
dynamics: the FG expansion links the $(26,8,312)$ boundary branch to the
bulk shift vector while exact ghost matching removes the framing anomaly;
Stinespring dark-ledger sinks balance Eulerian negative energies within
the Ford--Roman bound to the Planck scale; unit lapse and flat slices
guarantee global hyperbolicity with zero proper acceleration; the PIC
array, acoustic matching layer, and helium loop keep the emitter within
mechanical and cryogenic margins; and the LANR ledger closes with a
$+33.104$~kW surplus. Milestones: Phase~A completes gate/SMT validation
(this work), Phase~B nanophotonic PIC prototyping, Phase~C cryogenic
loop integration, Phase~D full co-simulation on $256^3$ meshes, and
Phase~E hardware-in-the-loop flight rehearsal.
